items.prompt: A man stands on the wooden porch of an old dacha at dawn, seen from behind, breathing in cold air, looking at a silent snowy forest; a grey cat sits on the step beside him.

alt.ru: Мужчина со спины стоит на деревянном крыльце старой дачи на рассвете и смотрит на тихий заснеженный лес; рядом на ступеньке сидит серый кот.
alt.en: A man from behind on the wooden porch of an old dacha at dawn, looking at a silent snowy forest, a grey cat on the step beside him.
alt.pt: Um homem de costas no alpendre de madeira de uma velha dacha ao amanhecer, a olhar para uma floresta silenciosa com neve, um gato cinzento no degrau ao lado.
alt.es: Un hombre de espaldas en el porche de madera de una vieja dacha al amanecer, mirando un bosque nevado y silencioso, un gato gris en el escalón a su lado.

items.prompt: A forest path in late November with light snow: three people walk toward a clearing, and in the middle of the clearing ahead of them already stands a young woman with dark hair, still and waiting, as if she had always been there. Seen from behind the walkers.

alt.ru: Лесная тропа в конце ноября, лёгкий снег: трое идут к поляне, а посреди неё их уже ждёт темноволосая девушка, будто стояла там всегда.
alt.en: A forest path in late November with light snow: three people walk toward a clearing where a dark-haired young woman already stands waiting, as if she had always been there.
alt.pt: Um trilho na floresta no fim de novembro com neve leve: três pessoas caminham para uma clareira onde uma jovem de cabelo escuro já espera, como se sempre lá estivesse.
alt.es: Un sendero en el bosque a finales de noviembre con nieve ligera: tres personas caminan hacia un claro donde ya espera una joven de pelo oscuro, como si siempre hubiera estado allí.

items.prompt: Evening on the porch of a dacha deep in a dark forest: four young people sit on the steps and the railing, wrapped in coats, a lantern beside them, the forest a black wall beyond the small circle of light.

alt.ru: Вечер на крыльце дачи в тёмном лесу: четверо молодых людей в куртках сидят на ступеньках и перилах у фонаря, за кругом света чёрная стена леса.
alt.en: Evening on a dacha porch in a dark forest: four young people in coats on the steps and rail by a lantern, the forest a black wall beyond the light.
alt.pt: Noite no alpendre de uma dacha numa floresta escura: quatro jovens de casaco nos degraus e no corrimão junto a uma lanterna, a floresta um muro negro.
alt.es: Noche en el porche de una dacha en un bosque oscuro: cuatro jóvenes con abrigo en los escalones y la barandilla junto a un farol, el bosque un muro negro.
